title: Harmonic Variables for Laplace Operators on Homogeneous Spaces
summary: A definition of harmonic variables for Laplace operators on Riemannian and pseudo-Riemannian spaces is introduced. Harmonic variables allow, in particular, the construction of particular (non-invariant group) solutions to a wide class of nonlinear differential equations. For Lie groups with a bi-invariant metric and a certain class of homogeneous spaces (e.g., symmetric spaces), an algorithm for constructing such variables is presented.
